blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual foundation models provide powerful representations for diverse tasks, but their features become stale as visual content changes between image observations. Refreshing them requires new frames and repeated runs of a computationally expensive image encoder. We introduce ALIVE, an event-based method that incrementally updates native foundation model features between image observations. Given an anchor image, ALIVE uses subsequent events to transport and correct existing multi-layer features extracted by a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Its lightweight updater is trained end-to-end using only synthetic data, without downstream task supervision, and transfers directly to real-world event streams without any adaptation. Across three real-world datasets and five task-dataset settings spanning object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, ALIVE outperforms all evaluated event-based methods in every metric. On DSEC, when the anchor frame is 200,ms old, ALIVE improves over anchor-image predictions by 30.9,mAP in detection, 11.6,mIoU in segmentation, and 15.9% in depth AbsRel. Compared with image re-encoding, ALIVE reduces FLOPs by 82.4% and latency by a factor of 2.5.
blocks.zh: 视觉基础模型为各种任务提供了强大的表现力,但其特性随着视觉内容在图像观察之间的变化而变得僵化. 刷新它们需要新的帧和重复运行一个计算昂贵的图像编码器. 我们引入了基于事件的方法ALIVE,在图像观测之间逐渐更新本土基础模型特征. 赋予锚定图像,ALIVE使用后续事件来传输和纠正由冷冻的DINOv3编码器提取的现有多层特性. 其轻量级更新器是经过训练的端到端只使用合成数据,不使用下游任务监督,并在没有任何适应的情况下直接转移到现实世界的事件流. 通过三个现实世界数据集和五个任务数据集设置,涵盖对象检测、语义分解和深度估计,ALIVE在每一个度量中都超越了所有评价的事件方法。 在DSEC上,当锚架为200,ms时,ALIVE比锚-影像预测改进了30.9,mAP在探测中,mIoU在分化中,15.9%在深度AbsRel. 与图像重编码相比,ALIVE将FLOP减少82.4%,延迟减少2.5倍.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Visual foundation models (VFMs) provide general-purpose features that a single frozen backbone can share across many tasks through lightweight heads [ 33 , 29 , 21 , 37 ] .
However, these features are computed from a single image and describe the scene only at the moment it was captured.
Between frames, they stay fixed while the scene keeps changing, and every prediction derived from them grows stale.
This staleness limits applications that must respond quickly, such as autonomous driving and robotics [ 13 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh:
视觉基础模型(VFMs)提供了一个单一的冷冻骨干可以通过轻量级头部在很多任务中共享的通用特征[33,29,21,37].
然而,这些特征是从一个单一的图像中计算出来的,并且只在拍摄到现场时才加以描述.
在帧之间,它们保持固定,同时场景不断变化,从它们得出的每一个预测都变得僵化.
这种乏味限制了必须迅速响应的应用,如自主驾驶和机器人[13,23].

blocks.en:
With a conventional camera, one must choose between two unsatisfactory options.
At a low frame rate, predictions remain stale until the next image arrives, and at a high frame rate, the VFM must run on every image at a high computational cost.
Event cameras offer a way out of this dilemma.
They report per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously with microsecond resolution [ 11 ] .
Paired with a frame camera, either on the same chip [ 6 , 2 , 22 , 17 ] or as a separate sensor [ 14 , 49 , 50 ] , they observe precisely the interval in which VFM features go stale.
blocks.zh:
使用传统的相机,必须在两个不满意的选择中作出选择.
在较低的帧率下,预测在下一张图像到达之前仍然保持停滞状态,在高帧率下,VFM必须以高计算成本运行在每个图像上.
事件摄像头为摆脱这种困境提供了一条出路.
它们报告每像素亮度与微秒分辨率同步变化[11].
佩尔戴着帧相机,或者在同一芯片上[6,2,22,17],或者作为一个单独的传感器[14,49,50],他们精确地观察了VFM特性变质的间隔.

blocks.en:
The question then becomes how to use events to keep perception up to date.
Most event-based methods train dedicated networks with task labels, e.g . , detection [ 31 , 16 , 18 ] , segmentation [ 1 , 38 ] , or depth estimation [ 12 ] .
Event-guided feature propagation [ 43 , 41 ] keeps the features of task-specific networks up to date between frames but is likewise trained with task supervision.
Each new task thus requires new labels and new training.
Task-agnostic alternatives avoid task labels, but each falls short in efficiency or accuracy.
Reconstructing images, from events alone [ 35 , 9 ] or from events and frames [ 48 ] , and encoding them with the VFM brings back the cost of running the VFM on every image.
Warping features with event-based optical flow [ 15 , 25 ] only moves existing content and cannot account for changes that motion does not explain.
Mapping events directly into the feature space of a VFM [ 8 , 32 ] discards the rich visual information already captured by the latest frame.
What remains missing is a task-agnostic update that builds on the latest frame, accounts for changes beyond motion, and costs only a fraction of re-encoding.
blocks.zh:
然后,问题就变成了如何利用事件来不断更新感知。
大多数基于事件的方法会训练带有任务标签的专用网络,如检测[31,16,18],分区[1,38],或深度估计[12].
事件指导特性的传播[43、41]使具体任务网络的特点在框架之间保持最新,但同样受到任务监督方面的培训。
因此,每项新任务都需要新的标签和新的培训。
任务不可知替代品可以避免任务标签,但每个选项在效率或准确性上都不足.
重构图像,单从事件[35,9]或事件和框架[48],并用VFM编码它们,每张图像都带来运行VFM的成本.
带有基于事件光学流的warping特性[15,25]只移动现有内容,不能说明运动没有解释的变化.
将事件直接映射到VFM的特征空间[8,32]丢弃了最新框架已经捕捉到的丰富的视觉信息.
尚缺的是一个基于最新框架的任务不可知的更新,它说明变化超出了运动范围,而且只花费一小部分重新编码的费用。

blocks.en:
Our key insight is that such an update should act on the features of the frozen VFM and can be supervised by the VFM itself.
These features are the common input of all heads, and updating them refreshes all predictions at once.
Encoding a later frame with the same VFM yields the features that the update should produce.
The update can therefore be learned without any task label.
Based on this insight, we propose ALIVE , a lightweight event-driven updater that keeps the features of a frozen VFM up to date between frames ( ).
We instantiate it with DINOv3 [ 37 ] .
Starting from the multi-layer features of the latest frame, ALIVE updates them with each incoming packet of events ( Fig. 2 ): it moves existing content along the motion observed by the events and corrects the changes that motion cannot explain.
At inference, parameter-free moment matching aligns the updated features with the statistics of the latest frame.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要见解是,这种更新应针对冻结的VFM的特点采取行动,并可由VFM本身监督。
这些特性是所有头的共同输入,更新后立即刷新所有预测.
编码一个具有相同VFM的后置帧,产生更新应产生的特性.
因此,可以在没有任何任务标签的情况下学习更新。
基于这一见解,我们提出ALIVE,一个轻量级事件驱动的更新器,使一个被冻结的VFM的特性在帧之间保持最新(.).
我们用DINOV3即兴表演
从最新帧的多层特征开始,ALIVE以每包接收到的事件(图2)更新它们:它沿事件所观察到的运动移动现有内容,并纠正运动无法解释的变化.
推论,无参数瞬间匹配更新的特性与最新框架的统计一致.

blocks.en:
We train ALIVE solely on synthetic RGB–event sequences [ 42 , 40 ] and apply it zero-shot to three real-world datasets, DSEC, DDD17, and CoSEC [ 14 , 5 , 30 ] , which cover object detection, semantic segmentation, and metric depth estimation in five task–dataset settings.
In each setting, a frozen head trained only on DINOv3 features of real RGB images reads the updated features.
ALIVE outperforms all compared event-based methods in all five settings.
On DSEC, when the latest frame is 200 ms old, it improves over reusing that frame’s features by 30.9 mAP in detection, 11.6 mIoU in segmentation, and 15.9% in depth AbsRel ( Fig. 3 ).
ALIVE has only 2.5M parameters, and each update requires 82.4% fewer FLOPs than re-encoding a frame with DINOv3 and runs 2.5 × 2.5\times faster, which makes it the only evaluated method fast enough to update at 200 Hz.

在DSEC上,当最新的帧是200 ms的旧时,它比重新使用该帧的特征要改进30.9 mAP的探测,11.6 mIoU的分区,15.9%的深度AbsRel(图3).

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We propose to keep the features of a frozen VFM up to date with events between frames, which refreshes all downstream heads at once and lets the VFM itself supervise the update without task labels. • We present ALIVE, a lightweight recurrent updater that transports and corrects multi-layer VFM features with events, together with a parameter-free moment matching that aligns its output with the latest frame. • We show that a single ALIVE updater trained only on synthetic data transfers to real data without any adaptation, outperforms all compared methods in all five settings, and is the only one fast enough to update at 200 Hz.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
The scarcity of labeled event data has motivated transferring knowledge from VFMs to event cameras, for open-world recognition [ 45 ] , language-grounded video object segmentation with Segment Anything [ 10 , 21 ] , and depth estimation [ 4 , 47 ] .
Beyond individual tasks, ScaleEvent [ 8 ] and REALM [ 32 ] train event encoders to reproduce dense VFM features.
These approaches recover rich representations from events alone, although events miss absolute intensity and anything that does not move relative to the camera.
Most of them also need an encoder as large as the VFM for every output.
We instead combine the strengths of both modalities: a frozen VFM extracts rich features from the latest frame, and a lightweight network updates them with new events.
blocks.zh:
贴有标签的事件数据很少,这促使人们将知识从VFMs转移到事件摄像头,用于开放世界的识别[45],语言基的视频物体分解与任何部分[10,21],以及深度估计[4,47].
除了单个任务,ScaleEvent [8] 和REALM [32] 列车事件编码器可以复制密集的VFM特性.
这些方法单独从事件中恢复了丰富的表现,虽然事件错过了绝对的强度和任何与相机无关的东西.
它们中的大多数还需要一个像VFM那样大的编码器,用于每个输出.
相反,我们结合了两种模式的优点:一个冷冻的VFM从最新框架中提取了丰富的特征,一个轻量级网络用新的事件来更新它们.

blocks.en:
Events can update visual representations between frames.
One line of work recovers images between frames, either from events alone [ 35 , 9 ] or by updating the latest frame with the subsequent events through direct integration [ 7 ] or a learned network [ 48 ] .
Extracting VFM features from these images, however, requires a full VFM forward pass for every update.
Event-based optical flow [ 15 , 25 ] can instead warp existing features, but warping only relocates them and cannot capture changes beyond motion.
ALIVE overcomes both limitations by transporting and correcting VFM features directly, at a fraction of the cost of VFM inference.
blocks.zh:
事件可以更新帧之间的视觉表现.
一行工作从单事件[35,9]或通过直接整合[7]或学习的网络[48],更新最新帧与后续事件之间的图像.
然而,从这些图像中提取VFM特性需要每次更新都有一个完整的VFM前传.
基于事件的光学流[15,25]可以转动现有的特性,但振动只会转移它们,无法捕捉超越运动的变化.
生存力通过直接运输和纠正VFM特征,以VFM推论成本的一小部分,克服了两种限制.

blocks.en:
Closer to our work, LiFR-Seg [ 43 ] propagates segmentation features from an RGB keyframe with event-guided motion, and the concurrent LiFR-v2 [ 41 ] adds event-guided feature completion and historical retrieval for segmentation and depth estimation.
Both rely on task supervision, and LiFR-v2 additionally requires a separate feature distillation stage before task-specific training.
ALIVE instead learns task-agnostic updates of frozen VFM features in a single stage, supervised only by the VFM features of subsequent frames and without modifying the VFM or the heads.
We show that a single updater trained only on synthetic data serves all evaluated tasks and real-world datasets without adaptation.
blocks.zh:
离我们的工作更近一些,LiFR-Seg [43] 传播了由事件引导运动的RGB键框的分块特征,同时LiFR-v2 [41] 增加了事件引导特征的完成和历史检索,用于分块和深度估计.
两者都依赖于任务监督,而LiFR-v2在任务特定培训前还需要单独的特性蒸馏阶段.
相反,LIVE在单一阶段学习冷冻VFM特性的任务不可知更新,仅受后续帧的VFM特性监督,不修改VFM或头部.
我们显示,一个仅接受过合成数据培训的单一更新器为所有评估任务和现实世界数据集服务,无需进行调整。

blocks.en: 3.2 ALIVE Updater
blocks.zh: 3.2 更新资料

blocks.en:
We instantiate Φ \Phi with DINOv3 ViT-B/16 [ 37 ] and use the outputs of its 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th blocks ( L = 4 L=4 ), each with 768 channels on a token grid of stride 16.
As the camera and objects move, the same content appears at other positions, and its features should move with it.

blocks.en:
After training, ALIVE transfers to real event streams without any adaptation ( Fig. 2 b).
Frozen heads trained on VFM features of real RGB images read its output directly, and a single updater can serve different tasks and datasets.

blocks.en:
Although feature supervision encourages ALIVE to reproduce VFM features, deviations that accumulate over many updates and differences between synthetic and real events can make the output channel statistics drift, which shifts the inputs of the frozen heads away from their training features.
The anchor features, extracted from a real frame of the same scene, provide a reference.
If the content in view only moved, the same feature values would appear at other tokens, and the distribution of each channel over the image would remain approximately the same.
We therefore introduce moment matching, which aligns the first two moments of every output channel, its mean and its variance, with those of the anchor, using the channel-wise affine transformation of adaptive instance normalization [ 19 ] .
With the mean μ t \mu_{t} and variance σ t 2 \sigma_{t}^{2} of an output channel over all tokens of the image, and the anchor moments μ 0 \mu_{0} and σ 0 2 \sigma_{0}^{2} computed from F 0 F_{0} in the same way, the moment-matched output is F ¯ t = ( σ 0 / σ t ) ⊙ ( F ^ t − μ t ) + μ 0 \bar{F}_{t}=(\sigma_{0}/\sigma_{t})\odot(\hat{F}_{t}-\mu_{t})+\mu_{0} .
Every channel of F ¯ t \bar{F}_{t} thus has the mean and variance of the anchor, while its standardized values, which form the spatial pattern of the channel, remain those predicted by ALIVE.
Moment matching has no parameters and acts only on the output, leaving the recurrence exactly as in training.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We train ALIVE on TartanAir V2 [ 42 , 40 ] , which provides high-frame-rate synthetic video with events.
Its 42 training trajectories yield 20,183 sequences of 200 ms after an anchor frame, each with 40 packets of 5 ms and a teacher frame after every packet.
We train for 3,240 steps with a batch size of 64.
blocks.zh:
我们在TartanAir V2[42,40]上训练ALIVE,它提供高帧率的合成视频,包含事件.
它的42个训练轨迹在一个锚架后产生20 183个200米的序列,每个锚架有40个5米的包,每个包后有一个教师框架.
我们训练3 240步,分批64步。

blocks.en:
We evaluate on three real-world datasets recorded with different event cameras.
DSEC [ 14 ] pairs RGB frames at 20 Hz with a Prophesee Gen3.1 event camera ( 640 × 480 640\times 480 ).
We use it for detection with the labels of DSEC-Detection [ 13 ] , for segmentation with the 11 classes of ESS [ 38 ] , and for depth with its 10 Hz disparity ground truth.
DDD17 [ 5 ] records grayscale frames about every 29 ms and events with one DAVIS346B sensor ( 346 × 260 346\times 260 ), which we use for segmentation with the 6 classes of EV-SegNet [ 1 ] .
CoSEC [ 30 ] aligns RGB frames with a Prophesee EVK4 event camera ( 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 ) and provides LiDAR depth for its frames.
Detection and segmentation are evaluated on the official test splits, and depth on six held-out DSEC recordings and the 14 Village trajectories of CoSEC.
blocks.zh:
我们评价用不同事件摄像头记录的三套真实世界数据集。
DSEC [14] 配有预言Gen3.1事件相机(640×480 640\times 480 )的RGB帧在20 Hz.
我们用它来检测DSEC-检测的标签[13],与ESS的11类分离[38],并用它的10赫兹差异地面真相进行深度检测.
DDD17 [5] 记录了每29米左右的灰度帧和事件,带有一个DAVIS346B传感器(346×260346\times 260),我们用它与EV-SegNet的6类进行分割[1].
CoSEC [30] 将RGB帧与预言EVK4事件相机(1280×720 1280\times 720)对齐,为其帧提供了LiDAR深度.
检测和分解在正式的测试分数上得到评价,在6个搁置的DSEC录音和14个村庄的COSEC轨迹上得到深度评价。

blocks.en:
For each setting, a head trained on DINOv3 features of the training frames is frozen: FPN [ 24 ] with Faster R-CNN [ 36 ] for detection, UPerNet [ 44 ] for segmentation, and a DPT decoder [ 34 ] for metric depth.
All methods share these heads and use one checkpoint each for all settings, which isolates the quality of their features.
Each test sample pairs a labeled target frame with an earlier anchor frame, and each method receives the anchor and the events in between.
We call the time between them the anchor age.
To compare ages on the same content, we fix the targets and use each of their four (DSEC) or six (DDD17) preceding frames as anchors, with ages of 50–200 ms and 29–176 ms.
This gives 36,260, 10,936, 12,216, and 23,340 samples for DSEC detection, segmentation, depth, and DDD17.
As the irregular frames of CoSEC do not allow common ages, we pool its 1,893 consecutive frame pairs (31 ms–1 s), and Fig. 3 covers the other settings.
blocks.zh:
对于每个设置,一个受过训练框的DINOv3特性培训的头被冻结:FPN [24],用于检测的更快R-CNN [36],用于分区的UPerNet [44],以及用于测量深度的DPT解码器 [34].
所有方法都共享这些头,并对所有设置各使用一个检查点,从而隔离其特征的质量.
每个测试样本将标有标签的目标框与更早的锚框对齐,每种方法都接收锚和介于两者之间的事件.
我们称它们之间的时间为锚年龄。
为了比较相同内容上的年代,我们确定目标,并使用他们前面的4个(DSEC)或6个(DDD17)帧作为锚,年龄为50–200 ms和29–176 ms.
这使36,260、10,936、12,216和23,340个样本用于DSEC检测、分解、深度和DDD17。
由于CoSEC的不规则帧不允许常见的年限,我们汇集了它的1,893个连续帧对(31 ms–1 s),图3涵盖了其他设置.

blocks.en: We report mAP, AP50, and AP75 on vehicles and pedestrians [ 13 , 28 ] , mIoU, and AbsRel and RMSE for metric depth within 0.1–30 m without scale alignment, pooled over all anchor ages unless stated otherwise.
blocks.zh: 我们报告mAP、AP50和AP75的车辆和行人[13、28]、mIoU、AbsRel和RMSE在0.1至30米范围内的公尺深度,除非另有说明,所有锚龄均不调整。

blocks.en:
We compare with representative methods of each approach in Sec. 2 , all yielding DINOv3 features for the same heads: flow warping (E-RAFT [ 15 ] , EDCFlow [ 25 ] ), image reconstruction from events (E2VID [ 35 ] , HyperE2VID [ 9 ] ) or from the anchor and events (VFPSIE [ 48 ] , direct integration (DI) [ 7 ] ) followed by DINOv3, event-to-feature mapping (ScaleEvent [ 8 ] ), and feature propagation (LiFR-v2 [ 41 ] ).
All learned baselines except E2VID and HyperE2VID (released weights) are trained or fine-tuned on TartanAir V2.
EDCFlow and LiFR-v2 also start from components trained on DSEC, and DI fits its contrast thresholds on each training split, whereas ALIVE never sees a real recording.
Stale RGB reads the anchor features, and Current RGB encodes the target frame itself, an upper bound unavailable between frames.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了第2节中每种方法的代表性方法,这些方法都为相同的头产生DINov3特征:流动摆动(E-RAFT [15],EDCFlow [25]),事件图像重建(E2VID [35],HyperE2VID [9])或主机和事件(VFPSIE [48],直接集成(DI) [7]),然后是DINov3,事件到地貌绘图(Stale Event [8]),以及特征传播(LifR-v2 [41])。
除E2VID和HyperE2VID(释放重量)外,所有学习到的基线均在TartanAir V2上经过培训或微调.
电子数据交换中心 Flow和LiFR-v2也从接受过DSEC培训的组件开始,DI在每次培训中都符合其对比阈值,而ALIVE从未看到过真实的记录.
Stale RGB读取主锚特性,当前RGB将目标帧本身编码,这是在帧之间无法使用的上限.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 与基线的比较

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Qualitative comparison on test samples. Each column shows one sample at its target time, and each view is followed by a zoom of the framed region.
The top four rows show the anchor frame, the events between the anchor and the target time (red: positive, blue: negative), the target frame, and the ground truth.
The other rows show the predictions of the frozen heads from the features of each method.
Detection: predictions in orange and ground truth dashed in green.
Depth: red (near) to blue (far), with one range per sample.
Apart from Current RGB, no method receives the target frame, and the ground truth is shown for reference only.
blocks.zh:
图4:试验样品的质量比较。 每个栏目在其目标时间显示一个样本,每个视图后会显示一个帧区域的缩放.
前四行显示主播框架,主播与目标时间(红色:正,蓝色:负)之间的事件,目标框架,以及地面真相.
其他各行从每种方法的特征中显示对冻头的预测.
侦测: 橙色和地面的预测 真相破灭成绿色

blocks.en:
As Tab. 1 shows, ALIVE is the most accurate method in every metric of all five settings.
It achieves this with a single checkpoint that has never seen a real recording, on three event cameras that differ from each other and from the simulated training events.
Compared with the stale features, ALIVE gains 24.6 mAP in DSEC detection and 34.2 in AP75, the metric that requires the most precise localization.
Our method also improves segmentation by 9.1 and 5.5 mIoU on DSEC and DDD17 and reduces AbsRel by 11.0% on DSEC and 4.9% on CoSEC, where even Current RGB improves on the stale features by only 9% (34% on DSEC).
blocks.zh:
作为 Tab. 1 显示,ALIVE是所有五个设置中每个度量中最准确的方法.
它通过一个从未见过真实录音的单一检查点,在三个事件相机上实现这一点,这些相机彼此不同,也与模拟训练活动不同.
与陈旧的特征相比,ALIVE在DSEC检测中获得了24.6 mAP,在AP75中获得了34.2 mAP,这个度量值需要最精确的本地化.
我们的方法还在DSEC和DDD17上改进了9.1和5.5 mIoU的分化,并将AbsRel在DSEC上减少11.0%,在CoSEC上减少4.9%,即使目前的RGB在分化特性上也只提高了9%(DSEC上减少34%)。

blocks.en:
The baselines show what such an update requires.
First, the anchor frame is essential: the methods that ignore it fall below the stale features in all segmentation and depth settings, since events mainly record moving edges and little of the static scene layout.
Second, the anchor frame alone is not sufficient: flow warping yields the strongest baselines for detection and segmentation, which shows that motion accounts for much of the change between frames, but it only relocates the features and degrades depth below the stale features.
LiFR-v2 is the strongest baseline for depth on DSEC but trails flow warping by 15 mAP in detection.
Updating the anchor image keeps its appearance, but VFPSIE stays below flow warping in detection and segmentation, and DI stays close to the stale features.
Only ALIVE, which transports the anchor features and corrects what transport misses, is the most accurate in all settings.
blocks.zh:
基线显示这种更新需要什么。
首先,锚框是不可或缺的:忽略它的方法在所有分块和深度设置中跌落到 Stale 特征以下,因为事件主要记录移动边缘,静态场景布局很少.
第二,仅靠锚架是不够的:流曲产生最强的探测和分化基线,这说明运动占了框之间的很大变化,但它只迁移了特征,使深度降低到 Stale 特征之下.
LiFR-v2是DSEC上深度最强的基线,但小径在探测中以15 mAP的速度流动.
更新锚定图像保持其外观,但VFPSIE在检测和分解时会停留在流向扭曲线以下,DI则保持与 stale 特征的接近.
在所有环境里,最准确的只有LIVE,它传送锚地特征,纠正运输缺失的东西。

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 shows examples.
The stale features keep objects at their anchor positions, which causes missed objects and false positives, as for the car and the pedestrian in the detection examples.
Flow warping moves objects but leaves copies behind, such as the second box of the pedestrian and the split lamp post in the CoSEC example.
Where events are sparse, as on the distant building in the DSEC depth example, the event-only methods show artifacts, and small moving objects are often lost.
ALIVE places all of these objects at their target positions, close to Current RGB.
blocks.zh:
图4显示了实例。
僵化的特征将物体放在锚位上,这造成了丢失的物体和假阳性,在检测实例中,汽车和行人也是如此.
流线摇摆会移动物体但留下复制件,如行人第二个盒子和CoSEC例子中的拆分灯柱.
在事件稀少的地方,如在DSEC深度的远处建筑上,只事件的方法显示文物,小移动物体往往丢失.
活着将所有这些物体置于其目标位置,接近当前RGB.

blocks.en: 4.3 Accuracy over Anchor Age
blocks.zh: 4.3 精确度超过锁定年龄

blocks.en:
As the bottom row of Fig. 3 shows, the stale features lose accuracy quickly as objects move away from their anchor positions.
ALIVE loses accuracy much more slowly, and its gain grows with the anchor age in all four settings, up to 30.9 mAP and 11.6 mIoU on DSEC, 7.6 mIoU on DDD17, and 15.9% in DSEC AbsRel.
The strongest baseline changes with setting and age, but ALIVE remains the most accurate method at every age.
blocks.zh:
Fig. 3的下行显示,随着物体远离锚位, stale 特性会很快失去准确性.
生存能力丧失精度的速度要慢得多,它的增益随着所有四种环境的锚龄而增长,在DSEC上达到30.9 mAP和11.6 mIoU,在DDD17上达到7.6 mIoU,在DSEC AbsRel上达到15.9%.
基准值随着设定和年龄的变化而变化最大,但生存线仍然是每个年龄最准确的方法。

blocks.en: 4.4 Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 效率

blocks.en:
ALIVE needs 65.0 GFLOPs and 4.66 ms per update with 2.50M parameters ( Tab. 1 ), about 3% of DINOv3-B, because it updates the existing features instead of running the VFM again.
Every baseline costs at least as much as encoding a frame with DINOv3 (369.5 GFLOPs).
Compared with re-encoding the current frame, ALIVE reduces the computation by 82.4% and the latency by a factor of 2.5, and it is the only method that processes each 5 ms packet within 5 ms and can thus update the features at 200 Hz.
In all four settings, ALIVE is both the most accurate and the fastest method ( Fig. 3 , top).
blocks.zh:
ALIVE需要65.0 GFLOPs和每更新4.66 ms的2.50M参数(Tab. 1),约为DINOv3-B的3%,因为它更新了现有的特性而不是再次运行VFM.
每个基线成本至少相当于用DINOv3(369.5 GFLOPs)编码一个帧.
与当前框架的重新编码相比,ALIVE将计算减少了82.4%,延迟系数减少了2.5,这是在5ms以内处理每5ms包的唯一方法,因此可以更新200hz的特性.
在所有四种设置中,ALIVE既是最准确的也是最快的方法(图3,最高).

blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate ALIVE on DSEC ( Tab. 2 ), retraining every variant except the one without moment matching, which only removes this test-time step.
blocks.zh: 我们在DSEC( Tab. 2 ) 上放弃生命, 重新培训每个变体, 除了没有瞬间匹配的变体,

blocks.en:
Events are indispensable.
They are the only source of information about the scene after the anchor, and without them, the updater keeps all its modules but falls to the accuracy of the stale features or below.
Feature transport is the most important module, in line with the strength of flow warping: without it, detection drops by 10.5 mAP and segmentation by 5.3 mIoU.
The memory adds 2.4 mAP, of which 1.0 is lost when it does not move with the features.
Residual correction and spatial refinement correct different errors: spatial refinement, which acts where neighboring features differ, matters more for AP75 and mIoU, whereas residual correction matters more for depth.
Together, they give the best detection and segmentation results.
Among the modules, moment matching has by far the largest effect on depth (AbsRel 0.162 → \rightarrow 0.129), which indicates that metric depth depends strongly on the channel statistics of the features.
blocks.zh:
事件是必不可少的。
它们是唯一关于主播之后的场景的信息来源,没有它们,更新器保留其所有模块,但落到 Stale 特性的准确性或以下.
特性运输是最重要的模块,符合流曲的强度:没有它,检测下降10.5 mAP,分解下降5.3 mIoU.
内存增加了2.4 mAP,其中1.0在不随特性移动时丢失.
剩余校正和空间精炼纠正了不同的错误:空间精炼作用于相邻特征不同的空间精炼,对AP75和mIoU更重要,而剩余校正作用较深.
它们共同提供了最好的检测和分解结果.
在这些模块中,瞬间匹配对深度的影响最大(AbsRel 0.162 →\rightarrow 0129),这表明度量深度在很大程度上取决于各特征的通道统计.

blocks.en:
Trained with ℒ distill \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{distill}} alone, ALIVE already outperforms all baselines in detection and segmentation on DSEC ( Tabs. 1 and 2 ), which shows that most of its accuracy stems from our architecture. ℒ spatial \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{spatial}} , which constrains the relations between tokens, matters most for depth and AP75, which both depend on the spatial structure of the features. ℒ temporal \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{temporal}} , which constrains the change between updates, improves every metric by smaller margins, except for mAP.
The two losses are complementary, and combining them gives the best result in every metric.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented ALIVE, a lightweight event-driven updater that keeps VFM features alive through feature transport, residual correction, spatial refinement, and moment matching. Trained on synthetic data without task labels, ALIVE generalizes to three real-world datasets, outperforming all baselines across five settings while supporting 200 Hz updates with 82.4% fewer FLOPs than frame re-encoding.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了一个LIVE,一个轻量级事件驱动的更新器,通过特性迁移、剩余修正、空间改进和瞬间匹配来保持VFM特性的生命力。 在没有任务标签的情况下对合成数据进行训练,ALIVE概括到三个现实世界数据集,在5个设置中比所有基线都出色,同时支持200赫兹更新,FLOP比帧重编码少82.4%.
